title: 第24章 挣钱难第25章 奥肯利
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
“竟然还有这种法术……”
高德对法术已经有了一定的认识，知道法术会有各种各样神奇的效果，惊人的破坏力与杀伤力只是诸多效果中的一部分。
但也没想到法术的效果甚至是广泛到能提高技艺。
“神导术。”高德暗暗留心，若是能脱离眼前的困境，以后必定要想方设法搞到神导术的法术配方。
毫无疑问，神导术绝对是魔药师、炼金术士等一切超凡工匠的必学法术。
至于现在，还是想办法搞钱吧！
两项大工程结束，高德继续盘腿而坐，开始今日的修行。
他当然也知道不论是引导法还是冥想术的修行，都是需要时间的积累，短时间内绝无可能有大的突破。
至少是在下一次试药前是不会有什么突破的。
而若是到了那时他没能反抗塞达法师成功，那现在的修行只是浪费时间。
偏偏这又是大概率事件。
这么看来，现在的努力没有必要？
可高德更明白，不论怎么样，都不是懈怠修行的理由。
对于所有人来说，只要有意识想成为一名强大的法师，修行就绝不能有偷懒休息可言。
这需要惊人的毅力。
可于每一个法师而言，这又是最为基本的东西。
逐渐的，高德内心放空，精神内敛，沉浸于引导法之中。
悄无声息间，世间无处不在飘荡着的充沛魔力随着他精神力的引导，流入高德的身体之中，再被一点一点地炼化为法力。
虽然施展法术消耗的是法力，但控制法术施放也需要精神力的参与。
所以，由于施展【修复术+】修复神导之戒，高德在开始修行的时候，精神力并不是最饱满的状态。

仅仅是在不到两个小时后，他精神力的损耗就达到四成的临界值，引导魔力的效率开始急速下降。
高德果断中断引导法的修行，转修学徒冥想术。
直到消耗的四成精神力在冥想术的作用下已然全部恢复，他今日的修行才正式结束。
一看时间，又已经接近深夜。
“第六瓣莲花也快要具现出来了，相比前身，引导法的修行速度没什么变化，但冥想术的修行速度似乎是变快了许多，是因为魂穿的缘故吗.......”
高德暗暗思索道：“引导法的修行天赋取决于体质，取决于身体与魔力的亲和度。”
“冥想术的修行天赋却是取决于灵魂，而我的灵魂天赋强于前身？”
大概率是如此。
但不管是什么原因，冥想术的修行速度有所提升总是好事的。
“该休息了，”高德心满意足地拖着疲惫的身体离开工作间，回到自己的房间休息。
.........
次日。
觉醒月，第十四日。
下午。
高德将今日份的一组初级蛛毒药剂调配完毕，他今日的工作便是告一段落。
不过还有一份额外的工作，原本是伊兰的工作。
药园里的药剂积攒了一定的货量，是时候送去菲尔魔药店了。
正好高德今日本就要前往城里，归还修复好的神导之戒。
他清点了一下这一批要送去的魔药种类与数量。
初级耐力药水，十组。

这是塞达法师所调配出的魔药，整座药园里也只有他能调配初级耐力药水。
初级蛛毒药水十三组。
这则是高德的劳动成果，并且其中有一组是属于他的。
content_en:
"There is actually such a magic..."
Gothe already has a certain understanding of spells and knows that spells have various magical effects. The amazing destructive power and lethality are only part of the many effects.
But I didn't expect that the effect of the spell was even broad enough to improve skills.
"Divine Guidance." Gothe secretly noticed that if he could get out of the current predicament, he would definitely find ways to obtain the magic formula for Divine Guidance in the future.
There is no doubt that divine guidance is a must-learn spell for all extraordinary craftsmen such as potions masters and alchemists.
As for now, let’s find a way to make money!
After the two major projects were completed, Gaode continued to sit cross-legged and began today's practice.
Of course, he also knows that the practice of both guidance and meditation requires time to accumulate, and there is absolutely no chance of a major breakthrough in a short period of time.
At least there won't be any breakthroughs before the next trial.
And if he fails to successfully resist Master Seda by then, then his current practice will be just a waste of time.
However, this is a high probability event.
It seems that the current efforts are not necessary?
But Gaode understood better that no matter what, it was no reason to slack off in practice.
For everyone, as long as they consciously want to become a powerful mage, there must be no laziness and rest in practice.
This requires amazing perseverance.
But for every mage, this is the most basic thing.
Gradually, Gaode became emptier, restrained his spirit, and immersed himself in the guidance method.
Quietly, the abundant magic floating everywhere in the world flowed into Gaode's body under the guidance of his spiritual power, and was refined into mana bit by bit.
Although casting spells consumes mana, controlling spell casting also requires the participation of mental power.
Therefore, due to the use of [Repair +] to repair the Ring of Divine Guidance, Gothe's mental power was not at its fullest when he started practicing.
In less than two hours, the loss of his mental power reached the critical value of 40%, and the efficiency of guiding magic began to decline rapidly.
Gothe decisively stopped practicing the Guidance Method and switched to apprentice meditation.
His practice for the day was not officially over until 40% of the consumed mental power had been fully recovered under the influence of meditation.
Looking at the time, it was already close to midnight.
"The sixth lotus petal is about to materialize. Compared with its predecessor, the speed of practicing the Guidance Technique has not changed much, but the speed of Meditation Technique seems to be much faster. Is it because of the Soul Penetration..."
Gothe thought secretly: "The talent for practicing the Guidance Method depends on the physical constitution and the affinity between the body and the magic power."
"The cultivation talent of meditation depends on the soul, and my soul talent is stronger than my predecessor?"
Most likely so.
But no matter what the reason is, it is always a good thing that the speed of meditation practice has increased.
"It's time to rest," Gothe dragged his tired body out of the workroom with satisfaction and returned to his room to rest.
.........
The next day.
Awakening month, fourteenth day.
afternoon.
Gothe has finished preparing today's set of primary spider poison potions, and his work for the day has come to an end.
But there was an additional job, originally Elayne's job.
A certain amount of potions have been accumulated in the medicine garden, and it’s time to send them to Phil’s Potions Store.
It just so happened that Gaode was going to the city today to return the repaired Ring of Divine Guidance.
He counted the types and quantities of the potions to be sent in this batch.
Elementary endurance potion, set of ten.
This is a magic potion prepared by Master Seda. He is the only one in the entire medicine garden who can prepare the primary endurance potion.
Thirteen sets of primary spider poison potions.
These are the fruits of Goude's labor, and one group of them belongs to him.
